mapper.select: SELECT workflow_binding_eligible FROM ai_tasks WHERE id=#{args[0]}
SELECT binding_hash,binding_json FROM task_workflow_bindings WHERE task_id=#{args[0]}
SELECT action_hash,action_json FROM task_workflow_actions WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} ORDER BY action_sequence
mapper.update: UPDATE task_workflow_actions SET action_hash=#{args[0]},action_json=#{args[1]},completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{args[2]} AND action_sequence=#{args[3]} AND action_hash=#{args[4]} AND completed_at IS NULL
UPDATE ai_tasks SET media_reworks=media_reworks+1 WHERE id=#{args[0]} AND media_reworks<1
